item.title: Reintroduce activity test, support in home-care amongst recommendations in latest Menzies Research report
item.description: A new discussion paper published by the Menzies Research Centre has called for a rethink of current early childhood education and care (ECEC) policy with a view to addressing concerns around program cost, parent choice and birth rates.

item.title: NSW Early Learning Commission delivers 876 compliance actions, completes 9,000 visits in unprecedented year
item.description: As the NSW Early Learning Commission approaches its inaugural anniversary the Minn’s Government has released details of the number of actions, fines and visits the body has completed so far this year as it moved to address child safety concerns across the state.

item.title: How do we confront the failures without condemning the profession?
item.description: To ensure a sustainable ECEC sector it is important that not all educators and providers be judged alongside providers or individuals who are failing to protect and care for children.

item.title: Parents have one of Australia’s most important jobs, so why don’t we have policy for them?
item.description: Australia invests billions in children annually, but we still struggle to keep them safe, happy and healthy. It’s time to include the missing puzzle piece: parents.
